artifacts.title: Plan: Deleting an unknown todo removes the last one
artifacts.markdown:
## Problem
`TodoStore.remove` (src/todos.ts) calls `this.todos.splice(index, 1)` without checking the index first. When the id doesn't exist, `findIndex` returns -1, and `splice(-1, 1)` deletes the last element. The function still returns false, so `DELETE /api/todos/:id` correctly answers 404, but the last todo has already been deleted.

## Approach
- Fix the root cause in the shared store method: return false before calling `splice` when the index is -1. The server handler (src/server.ts line 43) already maps false to 404, so it needs no change.

## Implementation steps
1. In `src/todos.ts`, change `remove` to:
   ```ts
   remove(id: number): boolean {
     const index = this.todos.findIndex((t) => t.id === id);
     if (index === -1) return false;
     this.todos.splice(index, 1);
     return true;
   }
   ```
2. In `test/todos.test.ts`, add a regression test: add two todos, call `store.remove(999)`, assert it returns false and that `store.list()` still holds both todos.

## Files likely touched
- src/todos.ts
- test/todos.test.ts

## Tests
- The new `node:test` case in test/todos.test.ts described in step 2.
- The existing test "remove deletes the todo" must still pass.
- Optional: a test in test/server.test.ts that calls `handle()` with DELETE `/api/todos/999` and checks for a 404 and an unchanged list. The store-level test already covers the root cause.

## Risks and open questions
- None significant. `remove` is only called from `server.ts`, and the return value for both cases stays the same.

## Size
S

payload.text:
I've written the plan; nothing in the repo has changed and no tests have been run. The bug is in `TodoStore.remove` in `src/todos.ts`. When the id doesn't exist, the lookup returns -1, and the code deletes the item at position -1 anyway, which is the last todo. It still returns `false`, so the server correctly sends 404, but by then the last todo is already gone.

**Fix:** return `false` before deleting when the id isn't found. The server code in `src/server.ts` already turns `false` into a 404, so it doesn't need to change.

**Test:** add one test to `test/todos.test.ts`: add two todos, call `remove(999)`, and check that it returns `false` and both todos are still there. A matching test through the server's DELETE endpoint is listed as optional.

Size is S.

I didn't open `test/server.test.ts`, so I haven't checked how the server tests are set up.
